Our Mission

We build technology to increase equality — so a shop owner in an informal market, a learner in a rural school, and a job seeker without formal certification all get the same shot as anyone else.

01 — Market access

Low-cost visibility for every business

Enzz Biashara puts any business owner online at a cost low enough that being invisible is no longer the default.

02 — Learning access

CBC learning, wherever you are

Taalo brings the same CBC-aligned resources to urban and rural learners alike, running on a low-cost smartphone.

03 — Opportunity access

Work and skills, without gatekeeping

Enzz Fursa connects certified and unskilled workers alike to real jobs — and the training that opens up more of them.

About

Why "ecosystem" isn't just a name

ENZZ — Ecosystem for Next Tech Zenith Zone — exists because most tools built for business, learning, and work are designed for people who already have access. We design ours for people who don't yet.

Our apps are built to work as one connected system: a business on Biashara is discoverable on Pata, a learner on Taalo is a future candidate on Fursa. Nobody has to start from zero twice.

01

AI at the core

Every app uses AI to reduce manual work and surface insight — inventory forecasting, business comparison, learner competency tracking.

02

Built for local reality

Designed around low-cost smartphones and the real constraints of Kenyan businesses, schools, and job seekers — not adapted from elsewhere.

03

Connected by design

Our apps share a common backbone, so progress in one part of a person's life — business, learning, work — lifts the rest.

Business · AI-Powered Live preview

Enzz Business / Biashara

Just ask the AI. Skip the menus.

Biashara strips the complexity out of running a business online. Tell the AI assistant what you want to do — check stock, log a sale, see how the shop is performing — and it takes you straight there, instead of you hunting through menus. One platform for inventory, orders, customer credit, finances, and your shop's online presence.

AI-Assisted Navigation

Say what you need in plain language — no learning a new interface.

Instant Digital Presence

Go live in minutes, so customers can actually find and reach you.

Smart Inventory Management

Scan products instead of typing — stock stays accurate, effortlessly.

Order Management

Every customer order tracked in one place — no more paper trails.

Credit & Customer Accounts

Track who owes what and watch balances — no notebook required.

Finance Tracking

See income and expenses at a glance for a clearer view of the business.

Marketplace Access

Get discovered — your products surface to customers already looking.

Affordable enough for every entrepreneur, powerful enough for every growing business — going digital is now an opportunity, not a privilege.

Education · CBC Live preview

Taalo

Where teachers, learners and parents grow together.

A CBC-aligned learning app built for a low-cost smartphone — teachers create AI-generated assignments and tests, track class mastery, and see each learner's competencies broken down by sub-strand so no one's true strengths, including in STEM, go unnoticed.

Gives urban and rural learners the same access to CBC resources and the same visibility into their potential.

Marketplace · AI Compare Live preview

Pata App

Discover. Compare. Order.

The customer side of Enzz Business/Biashara — browse local shops by location, view a business's full profile and products, and order directly or via WhatsApp. AI comparison between similar businesses is on the way.

Sends real customer demand to the small businesses that need it most, without an expensive ad budget.

Web · Jobs & Skills In development

Enzz Fursa

Find work. Find workers. Find your next skill.

A web-based platform for job posting and search — for certified and unskilled workers alike — with skill recommendations and courses that boost employability. Employers post gigs and hire fast; job seekers build a profile, get matched, and even find casual work through Vijana wa Mkono.

Opens the job market to workers without formal certification, alongside a path to get certified.

Why ENZZ

Built different, on purpose

Equity is the spec, not a slogan

Every feature is designed to close an access gap first — cost, geography, or certification — and add convenience second.

One ecosystem, shared value

Every app strengthens the others. A business on Biashara is instantly discoverable on Pata — no extra setup.

Rooted in Kenya, built to scale

We design for the realities of local businesses, schools, and job seekers first — then scale that model further.

Help us build the next zone of the ecosystem.

We're always open to talking with engineers, designers, and operators who want to build AI-powered products that make life better for Kenyans.
